inputSchema.description: one proof document; expected.verdict is VALID, VALID_PARTIAL or INVALID, expected.failed the failed checks as {id, code} in check order, expected.partial the sorted reasons that lowered the verdict (docs/protocol/VECTORS-FORMAT.md section 3)

proof.description: any JSON value: the proof under test

cases.description: a complete v8 proof (artifact, entries, transparency, checkpoint + chain path, receipt, one anchor)
no checkpoint and no chain path
a checkpoint without a chain path
an anchor of an unknown kind
artifact signature with its padding removed
artifact key revoked before the artifact was issued
artifact key revoked after the artifact was issued
artifact key not yet active at issue time
an entry field changed after sealing
the entries in the wrong order
a subject that none of the entries belongs to
issuedAt of the entries differs from the artifact timestamp
the transparency leaf documents another entry
the transparency inclusion proof names another position
the checkpoint is signed by another key
the chain path has a broken link
the chain path stops before the checkpoint head
the chain path does not start at the request's first entry
a chain path entry changed after sealing
the receipt is for another request
